verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Casium reviewing an individual's achievements and judging case strength, which is an attorney- or team-led assessment service, not a self-serve qualifier tool. Its EB-1A blog content lists eligibility criteria, but that is educational material rather than a structured check. 'No RFE or assessment fees' appears on the organizations page and does not establish a free self-serve O-1/EB-1 qualifier on the site.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a free structured eligibility check — a self-serve O-1/EB-1 qualifier or assessment tool on the provider's site
